_comment: Served at https://tidywl.com/config/netflix-config-v1.json. This checked-in copy is the source of truth for what gets uploaded — edit here, then upload, so the repo always shows what is live. Its shape and fallbacks are documented in src/content-scripts/remote-config.js.
_store_note: The store address is NOT here. It moved into src/utils/install-store.js on 2026-09-19, because it is fixed for the life of the listing and does not belong behind a file that has to be uploaded first.
_netflix_note: 2026-10-22: Netflix added loceEnabled and playbackRedirectEnabled to MiniModalQuery, both Boolean! = false. 2026-10-28: and includeUnlockButton, Boolean! = false. The extension guard ignores the default and skipped the leaving-soon check on every Sync. Delete this spot when a release ships the guard fix.
_pro_note: Read by 1.0.0's upsell card (src/utils/pricing.js) and by tidywl.com/netflix/pricing/, which must quote the same prices. Versions before 1.0.0 ignore it. The founding offer is ON since 2026-09-27 with no end date (the user: until further changes): $2.99 for the first month, $19.99 for the first year, then the regular prices. paddleDiscountIds are the Paddle discounts the pricing page hands to checkout, one per period, each limited to that period's price and to one payment; without an id for a period the page shows that period's regular price. Turning the offer off is enabled: false.

announcements.title: Update to 1.6.0 to fix the My List page

body.text: The My List page sometimes said **Netflix did not answer** instead of showing your titles. Nothing in your list changed.
**1.6.0 fixes it.** Chrome installs it by itself within a few hours. To get it now:

list: Press **Update** (top left), then switch Developer mode off

body.text: IMDb ratings on title cards can now be **switched off**, everywhere or only on My Netflix and My List. You can also pick how the rating badge looks.

list: Press **Settings**, then choose where the ratings show and which look you like

body.text: The dashboard has a new **Settings** group in its toolbar too, with a switch for its own IMDb ratings.

issues.title: The My List page sometimes didn't load
issues.body: When Netflix was slow to load, the My List page asked for your list before Netflix was ready, and said "Netflix did not answer. Try again in a moment." instead of showing your titles. Nothing was removed or changed.
issues.workaround: Nothing to do: 1.6.0 waits for Netflix before it asks, and Chrome installs it by itself.

updates.text: Found it: on a slow load the page asked for your list before Netflix had its data ready. Fixed in 1.6.0.

issues.title: Leaving soon labels stopped updating again
issues.body: Netflix changed the same part of its site again, and Sync skipped the check for titles that are leaving Netflix.
issues.workaround: Press **Sync** once and the labels catch up.

updates.text: Fixed without an update: Sync checks for leaving titles again.

issues.title: Leaving soon labels stopped updating
issues.body: Netflix changed something on its site, and Sync skipped the check for titles that are leaving Netflix. The labels went stale, and the toolbar's "There may be more" note did not clear.
issues.workaround: Press **Sync** once and the labels catch up.

updates.text: Fixed without an update: Sync checks for leaving titles again.
